speaker: Elder Maren
description: Elder Maren of Thornwick (plan sections 2.8.3, 4.6, decision 11): the village choice. Offers: the stolen cache (help_cache) or the field ogre (help_ogre); a stage-2 giant can loom over her (intimidate: 40 XP and Thunder Roar, once-flag reward.village.intimidate). The help reports hand over the cache or the news, and reward 120 XP, 2 iron ingots and Ancestral Mend (once-flag reward.village.help). Outcome flags are first-write-wins; every outcome opens the bridge (faction.village.gate_open), except force, which only the smashed barricade sets. A hostile village gets 'Get away from us!' and nothing else.

nodes.text: A giant... we want no trouble. Raiders took our winter cache, and an ogre tramples our barley. The bridge stays barred until we are safe.

choices.text: I'll bring back your stolen supplies.
I'll drive the ogre out of your fields.
[Loom over them] Open the bridge. Now.

nodes.text: The raiders camp in the old quarry, through the ravine beyond our north gate. Bring back our cache and the bridge is yours.
It sleeps in the barley past our south gate, and wolves follow it. Drive it off and the bridge is yours.
Have you been to the quarry? Our cache is in the raiders' camp, through the ravine beyond the north gate.

choices.text: [Loom over them] Open the bridge. Now.

nodes.text: The ogre still tramples our barley past the south gate.

choices.text: [Loom over them] Open the bridge. Now.

nodes.text: ...Open the bridge! Let it pass. Take what you came for and leave us be.
Our winter cache! You truly brought it back?
The fields are quiet... is the ogre gone?

choices.text: The ogre won't trouble you again.

nodes.text: Thornwick will not forget this. Take our iron - the smith will reforge your weapon - and let our healers teach you the old mending. The bridge is open.
Our smithy is yours, friend, and the bridge stays open for you.
The bridge is open to you.
